## Description

Contextual in-app guides per role (reception, nurse, doctor, admin) for first use; help centre articles (en/hi/ar); in-app feedback; public status page showing availability and incidents (no PHI). 30-minute role training packs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each role has a first-run guide covering its core loop and can dismiss/replay it.
- [ ] **AC2.** Status page reports monthly availability against the 99.5 % target and incident history.
- [ ] **AC3.** Feedback creates a ticket in the support tool with tenant id but no PHI unless the user attaches it deliberately (warning shown).
- [ ] **AC4.** Role training (30 min each) materials exist for the delivery package.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
